Hotels > Green Hostel Hanoi View all photos Green Hostel Hanoi Offering a luggage room, the comfortable Green Hostel Hanoi hotel lies in the Hoan Kiem district of Hanoi, just 1.3 km from the Temple of Literature and within 25 minutes' walk of such cultural places of interest as the Long Bien Bridge. In the vicinity of the majestic church "Saint Joseph Cathedral", this Hanoi hotel with 13 rooms features a lift and currency exchange. The hotel has a convenient location just 1.4 km from the modern Vietnamese Women's Museum, while shopping venues like the grand plaza "Ba Dinh Square" are merely 1.7 km away. At the Green Hostel Hanoi, you'll be in proximity to the fresh water Hoan Kiem Lake. To enrich your historical consciousness, visit the President Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, which stands nearly 20 minutes' walk from the property. This Hanoi hotel is a few steps from 18 bus stop.
